message.content:
There are 8 rows of pegs that the ball hits, so there are 8 left/right deflections.

To land in the middle slot, the ball must deflect right exactly 4 times and left exactly 4 times.

The number of ways to choose which 4 of the 8 deflections are right is

\[
\binom{8}{4}=70.
\]

Each specific sequence of 8 deflections has probability

\[
\left(\frac12\right)^8=\frac{1}{256}.
\]

Thus the probability is

\[
\frac{70}{256}=\frac{35}{128}.
\]

The answer is \(\boxed{\frac{35}{128}}\).
